---
format:
  typst:
    papersize: us-letter
    margin:
      x: 0.85in
      y: 0.75in
    fontsize: 10pt
    mainfont: "Libertinus Serif"
    output-file: CV_Nesslage.pdf
    include-before-body:
      - text: |
          #show heading: it => block(above: 1.2em, below: 0.7em)[
            #text(size: 11pt, weight: "bold", fill: rgb("#1c3029"), upper(it.body))
            #v(-0.6em)
            #line(length: 100%, stroke: 0.6pt + rgb("#3f8f82"))
          ]
          #show link: set text(fill: rgb("#2f6f66"))
          #set list(indent: 0.6em)
          #set enum(indent: 0.2em)
filters:
  - cv-dates.lua
toc: false
---
